questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "jitters" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "jitters" refers to nervousness or anxiety among investors about AI valuations.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的 "jitters" 指的是投資人對 AI 估值感到的緊張或不安。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX tumbles 2.31% as AI jitters and Nvidia-earnings nerves weigh

questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX close on November 17?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the index closed at 40,092.11 points after falling 947.97 points.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明指數在下跌 947.97 點後收於 40,092.11 點。

questions.question: How much market value did Taiwan's chip bellwether lose over two sessions?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the company lost roughly US$142 billion in market capitalization over two sessions.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明該公司在兩個交易日內損失約 142 億美元的市值。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "capping" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Capping" means setting a maximum limit, as the authorities limited intraday borrowed‑share sell orders.
questions.explain_zh: 「capping」指的是設定上限，因為當局限制了當日借入股票的賣出量。
questions.news_title_en: Regulators cut short-selling to steady volatile market

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "parred" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "parred" means investors reduced their AI exposure, i.e., they cut back on it.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「parred」指的是投資人減少 AI 的持倉，也就是降低了敞口。
